column1: review
Setup took me a whole afternoon. The onboarding checklist skipped half the things I actually needed.
The timeline view is the reason we switched. I can finally see who is overloaded without asking anyone.
Reports take forever to load once you have more than a few projects.
Pricing jumps too fast when you add one more seat. For a five-person agency it feels unfair.
Support replied in under an hour and actually solved the problem. Rare these days.
I wish there were ready-made templates for client onboarding. I rebuild the same project every time.
The Slack integration is great but notifications are way too noisy.
No decent mobile app. I can't update a task when I'm at a client meeting.
We love how clean the interface looks, but my team still asks where to find things.
Exporting reports to PDF breaks the layout every single time.
Took two weeks before the team actually started using it. Nobody understood what the tool wanted from them.
The price is fine for what it does, but I can't justify it to my boss without better reporting.
Great timeline, terrible search. I can never find an old task.
Support is slow on weekends. We had a client deadline on Saturday and heard nothing until Monday.
Templates would save me hours. Right now every new client means starting from scratch.
Integration with our invoicing tool would be a dream. I copy numbers by hand every month.
Honestly the onboarding emails were helpful, but they stopped after day three and I was still lost.
The comments feature is lovely, it keeps client feedback in one place instead of scattered across email.
Dashboard is slow and sometimes shows outdated numbers, so I double check everything in a spreadsheet.
We almost left because of the seat pricing. Another tool offers unlimited guests for free.
I need clearer permissions. Freelancers should not see every client project.
Mobile notifications arrive hours late, which defeats the purpose.
Switched from spreadsheets and never looked back. The timeline view alone is worth it.
I would pay more if reporting could be customized for each client.
